primaryText: Every farmer who owns a donkey beats it.
comment: Migrated from Phenomena/Anaphora/DonkeyAnaphora.lean strongDominant. Kanazawa's (1), p. 109, repeated in §2.1 (p. 115): '(1) seems to have the strong reading'; 'although the strong reading is the one standardly ascribed to (1), people's intuitions about (1) seem to be a bit shaky', and Chierchia (1990, 1992) 'claims that (1) can have the weak reading as well in appropriate contexts' (fn. 11: informants gave mixed judgments). Geach's (1962) original example was 'Any man who owns a donkey beats it' (fn. 19).
